title: Priority over sentiment
prompt:
Label urgent only if service is completely unavailable; otherwise normal. Message: "I am very angry about the new colors, but the service works." Return priority. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: priority. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
